scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @portable-codex/shared && npm run build --workspace @portable-codex/hosted-relay && npm run build --workspace @portable-codex/electron-companion
scripts.docs:openapi: npx --yes @apidevtools/swagger-cli@4.0.4 bundle docs/openapi.yaml -o docs/openapi.actions.json -t json && npx --yes @apidevtools/swagger-cli@4.0.4 bundle docs/openapi.yaml -o docs/openapi.actions.yaml -t yaml && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('docs/openapi.actions.json','utf8')); fs.writeFileSync('docs/openapi.actions.min.json', JSON.stringify(j));"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @portable-codex/shared && npm run test --workspace @portable-codex/hosted-relay && npm run test --workspace @portable-codex/electron-companion
